# PantryChef SG

> PantryChef SG is a kitchen app for Singapore households. It tracks what is in your fridge and pantry with expiry dates, suggests what to use up first, helps plan meals, builds a shopping list and shows estimated shop prices. Made by MAG-AMG Pte Ltd, Singapore.

Key facts
- Website and web app: https://pantrychefpro.com
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pantrychefsg.app
- iPhone: no App Store app; use the web version
- Prices shown are estimates from the app's own shop price list, not live shelf prices
- Free to download; optional Plus plan at S$3.98 a month or S$29.90 a year
- Support: cook@pantrychefpro.com

Pages
- [About](https://pantrychefpro.com/about.html): what the app is and who it is for
- [FAQ](https://pantrychefpro.com/faq.html): common questions with short answers
- [Privacy and terms](https://pantrychefpro.com/privacy.html): how data is handled
